title: Accu-Chek Combo Page not showing Values with 3.3.0.0
symptom: After update to version 3.3.0.0, on the Combo Page some values are missing: Driver Status, Last Connection to Pump, Battery, Reservoir. The data is present on the main page, so it is a display issue.
cause: The issue is a display problem affecting fields whose font color changes. In dark theme, the font color is black, making text invisible on dark background, unless warn or urgent colors are activated. This occurs when AAPS is set to dark background and the system default text color is used, which is black in automatic mode on Pixel phones.
fix: The issue was fixed by a commit (69dc95cf5181942551da7b6a7524d548a1f85bc9). A workaround is to set AAPS to use system design settings, or comment out the defaultTextColor assignments in the Combo tab layout.
